build_tokenizer_manager: build a TokenizerManager instance that tokenizes text and sends requests to the scheduler via ZMQ IPC
generate_request_streaming: generate a request with streaming output and yield incremental text chunks as they are produced
abort_request: abort a running or queued request by its request ID and clean up associated state
update_weights_from_disk: update model weights from disk with optional request abortion and weight version tracking
configure_logging: configure request logging settings including log level, format, and dump folders
